decision.rationale: Official UBC Vancouver UPLIFT Health Lab presents research on daily experiences, psychosocial well-being, healthy aging and cardiovascular health. Research is the host default; prospective-student participation and clearly labeled news and press sections receive explicit rules.
evidence: https://uplift.psych.ubc.ca/ | 872f2f6563ae6094809558caf06dfd64229e64cfce90e289d96591fb6879146c | The University of British Columbia; Vancouver campus; UPLIFT Health Lab; Our research is focused on understanding psychosocial well-being and biobehavioural mechanisms underlying healthy aging.

https://uplift.psych.ubc.ca/ | 872f2f6563ae6094809558caf06dfd64229e64cfce90e289d96591fb6879146c | Our areas of interest include: Biological and behavioural mechanisms linking daily experiences to long-term health and aging; The roles of positive experiences in stress and coping processes; Day-to-day dynamics of psychosocial well-being, sleep, and health behaviours; Biopsychosocial determinants of risk and outcomes for cardiovascular disease

https://uplift.psych.ubc.ca/ | 872f2f6563ae6094809558caf06dfd64229e64cfce90e289d96591fb6879146c | Homepage navigation labels /news/ as Lab News, /news-2/ as Press, /prospective-students/ as Prospective Students, with Undergraduate Students and Prospective Graduate Students subsections

https://uplift.psych.ubc.ca/ | 872f2f6563ae6094809558caf06dfd64229e64cfce90e289d96591fb6879146c | Homepage research sliders Daily positive events promote health and Positive experiences and stress processes link to /2013/03/04/hello-world-slider-2/ and /2013/03/04/hello-world-slider/; dated current news links include /2026/03/19/celebrating-dr-nancy-sin-2026-sbsm-fellow/ and /2026/03/19/incoming-graduate-students/

rules.rationale: Homepage-linked older slider pages describe research findings rather than current news.
Explicit prospective-student routes for joining the lab at undergraduate and graduate levels.
Clearly labeled lab news and press sections and dated lab announcements.

fallback.rationale: Health psychology lab research, publications, team and institutional context.
